area.text: lamina Paper — Sign, protect and redact

g01.text:
G01 Add a signature image
Purpose: put a picture of a signature on the page (draw, type, upload), clearly separate from a certificate signature.
States: signature field menu with the two named actions · capture dialog (draw / type / upload, empty and filled) · placed and selected with inspector · phone capture sheet.
Todos: E10c, E10j

g02.text:
G02 Sign with a certificate
Purpose: sign with a certificate from a file, the platform keychain or a smart card, with reason, appearance and a trusted timestamp.
States: identity chosen · no identity yet · token PIN · signing · signed and saved.
Todos: E10j, E10i, E10e

g03.text:
G03 Certify and lock
Purpose: certify as the first signature, choose which changes stay allowed (DocMDP) and lock fields (FieldMDP).
States: unsigned file (allowed) · already signed (certify unavailable, reason shown).
Todos: E10f

g04.text:
G04 Signature validation
Purpose: show on open whether signatures are valid, and explain each one in the Signatures panel.
States: valid · signer not trusted · changed after signing (allowed) · checking · revocation not reachable · certificate details.
Todos: E10g

g05.text:
G05 Revision diff and attack warnings
Purpose: show what changed after a signature, side by side, and warn when a change is not allowed or hides content.
States: allowed changes only · disallowed change (shadow attack) · overlay over content · cannot compare.
Todos: E10h

g06.text:
G06 Protect
Purpose: encrypt with AES-256, set open and permissions passwords, remove security, or protect for certificate holders.
States: password protect (signed-file conflict shown) · remove security (wrong password) · certificates (experimental).
Todos: E11b, E11c, E11e

g07.text:
G07 Sanitise
Purpose: remove hidden information by category, with counts before and a report after.
States: scanning · categories found · nothing to remove · report with each removed item.
Todos: E11d

g08.text:
G08 Redact mode: mark and review
Purpose: mark text and areas for redaction, review each mark, preview the result; nothing is removed yet.
States: marks pending, accepted, rejected · preview on (tweak) · no marks.
Todos: E12b

g09.text:
G09 Find sensitive content
Purpose: find emails, phone numbers, card numbers, IDs or a regex across every layer and mark them.
States: results · no matches · invalid regex · OCR text not available.
Todos: E12e

g10.text:
G10 Apply redactions
Purpose: confirm what applying does, then prove it with a per-layer verification report; saving stays blocked while a leak remains.
States: confirm (signatures named) · checking · leak found, save blocked · all checks passed.
Todos: E12c, E12d

g11.text:
G11 Phone: sign a document
Purpose: choose or make a signature image (or start a certificate signature), place it on the page and save.
States: sign sheet with saved signatures · placing with handles · saved.
Todos: E10j
